name: artifactguard
description: An agent that reports what the evidence supports for a museum material, built on Sanity Context MCP.
author: sagarchive

scripts.qa: npm run lint:project && npm run lint:seed && npm test && npm run benchmark && npm run redteam && npm run fuzz && npm run sweep && npm run smoke
scripts.lint:seed: node scripts/seed-lint.mjs && node scripts/build-seed.mjs --check && node scripts/build-fixture.mjs --check
